description: Comprehensive Atomic Fizz Caps loot drop tables — tiered, faction-specific, timeline-specific, NFT-eligible

common.name: Scrap Metal
common.description: Rusted chunks of pre-war steel. Smells like rain.

common.name: Cloth Rags
common.description: Fragments of pre-war fabric. Still useful for patching and padding.

common.name: Dirty Water
common.description: Contaminated water. Hydrating and mildly irradiating.

common.name: .38 Rounds
common.description: Common pistol caliber. Found everywhere. Means nowhere is safe.

common.name: Bobby Pin
common.description: Invaluable for locks. Terrible as a hairpin.

common.name: Pre-War Food Can
common.description: Preserved before the bombs. The taste has changed, but it's technically food.

common.name: Duct Tape
common.description: Pre-war adhesive tape. Still the most useful object in the wasteland.

common.name: Wood Planks
common.description: Rough-cut planks. Useful for building and burning.

common.name: 9mm Rounds
common.description: Standard pistol ammunition. Pre-war and still plentiful.

common.name: Glass Bottle
common.description: Pre-war glass. Useful for molotovs, storage, and desperate scrap.

uncommon.name: Stimpak
uncommon.description: Auto-injecting medical solution. The wasteland's primary healthcare plan.

uncommon.name: RadAway
uncommon.description: Intravenous radiation treatment. Tastes like regret.

uncommon.name: 5.56mm Rounds
uncommon.description: Intermediate rifle caliber. The NCR's favorite.

uncommon.name: Pipe Pistol
uncommon.description: Crudely assembled but functional. Fires when it fires.

uncommon.name: Leather Armor Piece
uncommon.description: Cured hide stitched over foam backing. Better than nothing by exactly enough.

uncommon.name: Fusion Cell
uncommon.description: Energy weapon ammunition. Compact and powerful.

uncommon.name: Mentats
uncommon.description: Cognitive enhancement chems. Pre-war pharmaceuticals at their finest.

uncommon.name: Jet
uncommon.description: Brahmin dung-derived speed enhancement. Don't think too hard about the source.

uncommon.name: Lockpick Kit
uncommon.description: Professional-grade lock picking tools. Legitimate uses are rare.

uncommon.name: Combat Knife
uncommon.description: Military-issue blade. Pre-war quality means it's still sharp.

uncommon.name: Buffout
uncommon.description: Strength and endurance enhancement. Pre-war athletes used this.

uncommon.name: .308 Rounds
uncommon.description: High-powered rifle ammunition. Preferred by snipers.

rare.name: Laser Pistol
rare.description: Institute-adjacent energy weapon. Precise, quiet, and very effective.

rare.name: Ultra Stimpak
rare.description: Military-grade field trauma injector. Rapid full-spectrum healing.

rare.name: Scoped Hunting Rifle
rare.description: Bolt-action precision rifle with pre-war optics. Still accurate at 600m.

rare.name: Psycho
rare.description: Combat stimulant with extreme side effects. The damage is real; so is the perception.

rare.name: Reflex Sight (Energy)
rare.description: Precision aiming reticle for energy weapons. Adds targeting precision.

rare.name: Pre-War Circuit Board
rare.description: Functional pre-war electronics. The foundation of advanced crafting.

rare.name: Rad-X
rare.description: Radiation resistance pharmaceutical. Pre-exposure is the smart play.

rare.name: Military Assault Rifle
rare.description: Full-auto military rifle. Pre-war military spec with the maintenance to match.

rare.name: Advanced Surgical Kit
rare.description: Full surgical toolkit in a hardened case. Followers of the Apocalypse standard.

rare.name: Stealth Boy
rare.description: Personal stealth field generator. Render yourself temporarily invisible.

epic.name: Plasma Rifle
epic.description: Military-grade plasma projection weapon. Reduces targets to goo. Very tidy, actually.

epic.name: T-45 Power Armor Helmet
epic.description: Pre-war powered armor helmet. Full HUD display, environmental sealing.

epic.name: Gauss Rifle
epic.description: Magnetic accelerator sniper weapon. Hits harder than anything short of a mini-nuke.

epic.name: Ballistic Weave Schematic
epic.description: Railroad-developed ballistic weave armor technology schematic.

epic.name: Military Fusion Core
epic.description: Full-capacity military fusion core. Powers power armor and fusion generators.

epic.name: X-Cell
epic.description: Pre-war performance enhancement beyond anything legal. Every SPECIAL +1.

epic.name: Anti-Materiel Rifle
epic.description: Massive caliber precision rifle for eliminating vehicles and power armor.

epic.name: Railroad Coat (Legendary)
epic.description: Railroad agent's legendary armored coat. Built for surviving courier work.

legendary.name: Fat Man
legendary.description: Portable nuclear catapult. Pre-war military's most compact act of insanity.

legendary.name: Grognak's Axe
legendary.description: The legendary axe of Grognak the Barbarian, escaped from a comic book and somehow real.

legendary.name: Prototype Gauss Pistol
legendary.description: Pre-war research prototype. Only three were ever built. One is in the Smithsonian. One is lost. This is the third.

legendary.name: Lucky Magnum
legendary.description: The Lucky .44 Magnum. Critical chance doubled. Found on every notable corpse in New Vegas.

legendary.name: Overseer's Legendary Coat
legendary.description: The actual coat of a Vault-Tec Overseer who walked into the wasteland and never came back.

legendary.name: Proto-FIZZ Authentication Chip
legendary.description: A Vault-Tec pre-war master authentication token. Access to every Vault's resource reserve database.

legendary.name: T-51b Power Armor (Full Set)
legendary.description: Complete T-51b power armor set, pristine condition. The peak of pre-war personal armor.

legendary.name: Alien Blaster
legendary.description: Not of this earth. Literally. Disintegrates most organics on contact.

nft_items.name: FIZZ Genesis Token
nft_items.description: One of 77 Genesis Tokens minted when FIZZ launched. Proof of original wasteland survival.

nft_items.name: Vault 77 Overseer Badge
nft_items.description: Official badge of a Vault 77 Overseer. Grants administrative status in any surviving vault.

nft_items.name: Wasteland Explorer Sigil
nft_items.description: Awarded to players who have claimed 50 unique GPS locations. A mark of genuine wandering.

nft_items.name: Faction War Veteran Token
nft_items.description: Proof of surviving 100 faction raid encounters. The wasteland remembers.

brotherhood_of_steel.drop_note: Brotherhood soldiers carry energy weapons and power armor components

ncr.drop_note: NCR soldiers are well-armed with conventional ballistic weapons

raiders.drop_note: Raiders carry improvised weapons and scavenged armor

institute.drop_note: Institute synths carry advanced technology rarely seen in the wasteland

railroad.drop_note: Railroad agents specialize in stealth and mobility

children_of_atom.drop_note: Children of Atom carry radiation weapons and religious artifacts

gunners.drop_note: Gunners are professional mercenaries with military-grade equipment

enclave.drop_note: Enclave soldiers carry the most advanced technology available

super_mutants.drop_note: Super Mutants favor heavy weapons and rarely use armor

fallout_1.era_flavor: First-generation post-war technology. Crude but functional.

fallout_2.era_flavor: Mature wasteland technology. Two generations of improvisation.

fallout_3.era_flavor: Capital Wasteland salvage. Rough but creative.

fallout_76.era_flavor: Early wasteland tech. The first survivors made do with very little.

fallout_tactics.era_flavor: Midwest Brotherhood salvage. Military surplus emphasis.

perk_energy_weapons.description: All energy weapons deal 20% more damage

perk_ballistic_weave.name: Ballistic Weave
perk_ballistic_weave.description: Can apply ballistic weave to clothing and outfits

achievement_50_pois.description: Awarded for claiming 50 unique GPS POI locations
